messages.subject: Solstice - completion tomorrow (12 Sept)
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

We're set for completion tomorrow at 10.00. Please have ready for e-signature: the SSA, Investor Rights Agreement, the Disclosure Letter, the shareholders' written resolution and the board minutes. The amended articles will be adopted by the written resolution. Daniel Okonkwo joins the board as Investor Director on completion; Priya as observer.

Once Ardent's funds are confirmed received we'll release signatures and update the register of members. Post-completion I'll file SH01, AP01 and the amended articles.

Best,

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1190
